scientific_integrity: Explicit use of the published RLE bounds and independent finite checks; no independent validation claimed. The five-run conditional distribution is not an unrestricted random-string law.
scientific_limitations: Bounded remainder is not exact; density not simplified, primary full text for 2015 statistics study was inaccessible. Novelty search is non-exhaustive.
title: A five-run limit law for minimal absent factors of binary words
